python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1173,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer);","note":"When proxy protocol handling is enabled, the request parser inspects the beginning of attacker-controlled input before normal HTTP parsing."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1153,"var":"buffer","code":"switches on the first four bytes of buffer to select PROXY v1 or v2 parsing","note":"A payload starting with CRLFCRLF selects the v2 parser path."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":225,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The v2 parser interprets the attacker-controlled bytes as a fixed-size PROXY v2 header."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":232,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);","note":"The advertised length is read from the header and added to the fixed signature size."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;","note":"The parser only accepts headers whose total size is no larger than the local proxy_header_v2 struct."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":238,"var":"proxy->from.ipv4 / proxy->to.ipv4","code":"copies source/destination address and port fields from hdr into request->proxy","note":"For the TCP4 family, attacker-controlled fields are written into the request proxy state and used later by the server."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":260,"var":"helper->crlfcrlf","code":"helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"After advancing past the header, the parser rescans the remaining buffer for the end of the HTTP headers; malformed size handling here can misalign subsequent parsing."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1178,"var":"path","code":"identify_http_method(request, buffer); identify_http_path(request, path);","note":"If parsing continues past the proxy header, the remaining bytes are treated as HTTP request data and may be read from an incorrect position."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
PY
